use_case: Automated tenant screening: the property management platform's integrated screening service scores each rental application and returns accept, accept with conditions (higher deposit), or decline with reason codes
vendor_or_model: Tenant screening provider integrated in SYS-10 (vendor scoring model on consumer report, eviction, criminal record, and income data)
data_categories: Applicant identity data; Social Security number; consumer report; eviction and criminal records; stated and verified income
human_in_the_loop: Leasing manager reviews every decline and conditional approval against written criteria (from 2026-11-30); today the recommendation is followed in about 97% of cases
applicable_laws: Fair Housing Act (42 U.S.C. 3604); 24 CFR 100.500 (in force; removal proposed); state fair housing laws (Florida worked example: Fla. Stat. 760.23); FCRA (15 U.S.C. 1681m(a); 16 CFR 682.3); CCPA ADMT and risk assessment rules (Cal. Code Regs. tit. 11, 7150; 7200-7222) for California homes; Colorado SB26-189 for Colorado homes; FTC Act Section 5
status: In production (about 64,000 applications a year in 6 states)
state_admt_scope: California (ADMT for a significant decision about housing, to the extent outside the FCRA exemption) and Colorado (covered ADMT in a consequential decision) from 2027-01-01
protected_characteristic_inputs_or_proxi: No protected characteristics as inputs; eviction filings, criminal records, and credit history are known proxies for race and national origin
bias_testing_status: Vendor-supplied data plus a first local test (2026-08): estimated approval ratio 0.76 for applicants estimated Black (flag); full local testing due 2027-03-31 (POAM-019)
monitoring: Quarterly approval-rate ratios by estimated group; monthly 20-report accuracy sample; override and dispute rates

use_case: Buyer lead scoring and buyer pre-qualification assistant: the CRM scores inbound buyer inquiries and a company model on Cloud provider B answers general financing questions and suggests price ranges
vendor_or_model: CRM vendor scoring feature plus company-built models and a hosted language model on Cloud provider B
data_categories: Inquiry contact data; ZIP code; inquiry language; price range; pre-approval status; web activity; chat transcripts
consequential_decision_category: Housing (access to brokerage services); not a decision to provide or deny housing
human_in_the_loop: Every lead is routed to an agent; the score sets follow-up order only; the assistant hands financing questions to licensed lenders
applicable_laws: Fair Housing Act (42 U.S.C. 3604(b), (c), (d)); FTC Act Section 5; CCPA notice at collection (Civ. Code 1798.100); RESPA 12 CFR 1024.15 when leads go to the mortgage joint venture
state_admt_scope: None: not a significant or consequential decision (Colorado excludes marketing and product recommendations); re-tier to High if used to decline representation or limit listings shown
protected_characteristic_inputs_or_proxi: ZIP code and inquiry language are proxies for race and national origin
bias_testing_status: Local outcome test (2026-07 to 2026-08): Spanish-language inquiries waited a median of 9 hours for first contact against 2 hours for English (flag)
monitoring: Monthly first-contact time parity by language and area; quarterly assistant answer accuracy sample

use_case: Agent recruiting and retention scoring: ranks prospective agents to recruit and current agents at risk of leaving; managing brokers use it to prioritize outreach and commission split offers
vendor_or_model: Company-built model on Cloud provider B using agent production data
data_categories: Agent production and transaction history; license data; tenure; office; public social profiles
human_in_the_loop: Managing broker decides any offer; no automated offers
applicable_laws: CCPA ADMT rules (Cal. Code Regs. tit. 11, 7001 significant decision includes independent contracting compensation) for California agents; FTC Act Section 5; state anti-discrimination laws
committee_review: Not reviewed (entered as an analytics project; review due 2026-11-30)
protected_characteristic_inputs_or_proxi: Tenure and office location may act as proxies for age and other protected characteristics

data_categories: Property features; photos; agent notes (no client personal data allowed)

status: In production (daily report; real-time alerts due 2027-01-31)
state_admt_scope: None (Colorado excludes cybersecurity and fraud tools)
monitoring: Monthly precision and recall against confirmed fraud cases
